sentences.en: Their job is to read the news clearly and carefully.
sentences.zh: 1. 他们的工作是清晰而仔细地播报新闻。

sentences.en: I think to clearly distinguish opinion from fact is important.
sentences.zh: 2. 我认为明确区分观点和事实很重要。

sentences.en: Our diplomacy and our military strategy were clearly in contradiction.
sentences.zh: 3. 我们的外交政策和军事战略显然是矛盾的。
